body.name: W_hat_loc
body.construction: For a fixed regular population branch \(W\), choose a fixed closed Frobenius ball centered at \(W\) that contains no other raw branch. There is a sufficiently small neighborhood of the population moment \(z\) on which the global minimizer of \(\lVert F_{\mathrm{res}}(U;\widehat z)\rVert_2^2\) over this ball is unique; for \(\widehat z\) in that neighborhood, denote this contraction-selected minimizer by \(\widehat W_{\mathrm{loc}}\).
